wave: IND-6b (India acquisition - group B: Maruti Suzuki, UltraTech Cement, Sun Pharmaceutical, Larsen & Toubro)
policy: All files listed are real, unmodified documents exactly as served by the cited official source (exchange archive or company IR site). Nothing was invented, rounded, or synthesized. No anti-bot protection was bypassed: files were fetched through a normal interactive browser session (no captchas solved, no credentials, no cookie forging, no aggregator scraping; SPEC 2.4.6). Every file listed was (re)fetched by this milestone through the browser on 2026-09-11 and verified byte-exact by sha256 after transfer. Files found already in storage from an earlier same-day session (a prior attempt of this milestone that died before documenting) were re-fetched and confirmed byte-identical before being accepted - nothing is claimed on the earlier session's word. Two unverified artifacts left by the earlier session (a rendered-HTML UltraTech press release and a BSE results-summary JSON) could NOT be byte-verified and were removed rather than accepted; see storage_cache_only notes and the addendum.

fetch_methods_used.browser: real Chromium session (Playwright); same-origin page-context fetch inside the served document/origin, base64 transfer, sha256 verified after decode. NSE integrated-filing JSON API called from the www.nseindia.com page's own session.

fetch_session.rate_limiting: single-shot low-volume fetches spaced >= 4 s apart per host; no throttling responses or rate-limit headers encountered. One navigation to www.bseindia.com timed out at the tool's 30 s limit; the page completed loading in the background ~6 s later and verification proceeded normally (no retry storm). One same-origin fetch was attempted from the wrong origin (investors.larsentoubro.com -> nsearchives.nseindia.com) and failed with a fetch error per CORS; re-navigating to nsearchives first resolved it.
fetch_session.taxonomy_note: Per-instance taxonomy versions observed: all four Q1 FY27 consolidated instances (filed Jul 2026) carry 'IFIndAs V2.1 (26-06-2026)'; all four April/May-filed Q4+FY26 consolidated originals carry 'IFIndAs V2.0 (06-02-2026)' - including L&T's Q4 consolidated Original filed 05-May-2026. The two L&T Q4 STANDALONE revisions (07-May/06-May-2026) still carry V2.0. No consolidated revision exists in this group.
